title: TDD gate: mandatory testing before merge

comments.author: cli
comments.body: ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ADDENDUM (2026-10-26). Merge gate: main does not receive the ticket engine until all of the following pass in a clean clone on the Docker-capable VM from ticket #35: npm ci && npm test (120 tests), ticket-engine validate exits 0, npm run build succeeds, and the end-to-end smoke run (./lab <disposable-workspace> --unsafe-recurse -> create/update a ticket -> ./lab stop) succeeds. The gate must be a committed script/CI job, not a manual checklist.
